title: Conditions to check for Mobile Limitations

question.author: member_138
question.body: Could support clarify mobile limitations in the current CloudBox version? I want to avoid relying on an outdated post.

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Mobile Apps documentation says: Uploads from mobile clients support files up to 20 GB, subject to free-space checks on the device. Files stored offline are encrypted with the device's own disk encryption; the app adds no additional encryption layer. The mobile app does not support selective sync, bandwidth throttling, or LAN sync. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
